name: Tea Lady
ability: If both your alive neighbours are good, they can't die.
interaction: None. The Storyteller keeps Can not die reminders on both alive neighbours while both are good.

rulings.text: Neighbours are the nearest alive players, skipping the dead; update immediately on deaths and alignment changes.
Protected neighbours survive Demon, Godfather and Gossip kills and execution (announced as executed, still alive); the Assassin still kills them.
Survival looks the same as Pacifist, Sailor and Fool effects.
Night order numbers are from bra1n/townsquare src/roles.json (develop branch), not the botc-release list.
